status: [미사용] Rejected candidate removed at user request; source metadata and comparison results retained as historical records.
license: Meshy account/model output terms not supplied or verified

comparison.method: Identical orthographic cameras, lighting, Cycles 16 samples and AgX; both displayed at unit bounding-box height without modifying source files; hair included in Tripo height; additional neutral material renders remove textures and normal maps.
limitations: Different input references: Tripo v2 with hair and pointed feet versus Meshy v3 bald and revised feet.
Unknown generation versions, settings and original face targets.
No rigging or animation tests. Boundary diagnostics after 1e-5 source-unit welding are not proof of deformation quality.
findings: Tripo has clearer modeled eyelid and lip definition in neutral-material head view.
Meshy head and shoulder silhouettes look more faceted, with less defined eye/lip geometry.
Meshy visible thumb and fingertips are sharply distorted; Tripo hand is smoother but finger separation still needs inspection.
Meshy heels are much closer to forefoot height than Tripo; toe deformation remains.
Meshy has 12282 triangles versus Tripo 11493, approximately 6.9 percent more, and three 2K material maps versus one 2K base-color map.
Meshy has one welded diagnostic component and 38 boundary edges versus Tripo sixteen components and 575 boundary edges; counts alone do not establish overall quality.
comparison.recommendation: For this pair, Tripo has better face/hand finish. Keep Meshy as a bald, near-flat-footed candidate requiring face/hand/toe and clothing separation work; do not generalize to service-wide ranking.
